summary: The typed client a service uses to call revex-wallet-gatekeeper instead of a hand-rolled InternalRequest. One method per Gatekeeper route, every failure a typed WalletError with a stable code, client-side metrics per calling service and feature, and per-caller settings polled from Gatekeeper.

gatekeeperPr.title: fix(gatekeeper): make error responses machine-readable for callers

adoption: No service outside platform-core lists either package name as a dependency (GitHub code search). Published on the beta tag only.

options.name: sourceId
options.purpose: The calling service's SERVICE_NAME. Sent as sourceId; metric label source_id.

options.name: module
options.purpose: The feature making the calls (sms-outbound, ai-agent). Metric label and x-gatekeeper-sdk-module header. Keep it low-cardinality: a feature name, never an id.

options.name: timeoutMs
options.purpose: Per-call timeout. Setting it pins it, so Gatekeeper can no longer change it for this client.

options.name: metrics
options.purpose: Record SDK metrics. Setting it pins it.

options.name: remoteConfig
options.purpose: Poll Gatekeeper's /sdk-config. false turns it off; a custom ConfigSource replaces it.

methods.name: validateCompanyEvent
methods.signature: validateCompanyEvent({ companyId, product, subProduct?, reserveUsage?, reserve?, fundCheck? }, { throwOnDenied? })
methods.note: A denial throws ACCESS_DENIED even though Gatekeeper answers 200. A repeat holds again.

methods.name: validateLocationEvent
methods.signature: validateLocationEvent({ companyId, locationId, product, subProduct?, reserveUsage?, reserve?, fundCheck? }, { throwOnDenied? })
methods.note: Only location rules and the location counter apply.

methods.name: validateAndBillEvent
methods.signature: validateAndBillEvent({ companyId, locationId, product, subProduct?, reserveUsage?, chargeId, billing })
methods.holds: Yes, then charges in the same call
methods.note: For billing after the fact. Billing dedups chargeId, but the hold repeats. Billing's ALREADY_PROCESSED returns replayed: true.

methods.name: billEventSuccess
methods.note: Repeat with the same chargeId. A repeat (Gatekeeper answers 422) returns replayed: true. BILL_RETRY_PENDING means Billing will be retried: do not release.

methods.name: billEventFailure
methods.note: Never call it after BILL_RETRY_PENDING: Gatekeeper still accepts it on a parked charge.

methods.name: getLocationUsage
methods.note: Usage for dashboards. forwardUserIdentity: false strips the end user's authorization and source headers so Gatekeeper sees a service-to-service read.

errors.when: Policy denied the action: validate calls (200) and validate-and-bill (400). Details: blockReasons, resumeAfterTimestamp.
errors.action: Block the action. Nothing is held.

errors.when: Billing returned 5xx; Gatekeeper parked the charge and its retry sweep will bill it.
errors.action: Do not call billEventFailure. Treat it as billed later.

errors.when: Billing refused the charge (4xx) and holds were released. Not used for ALREADY_PROCESSED.
errors.action: Don't repeat as-is. upstreamCode carries Billing's code.

errors.when: Opt-in was switched off since the hold; holds released.
Settle body names a different company, location or product than the hold.
Success on a failed event, or failure on a charged one.
Company and location events don't belong together.
Caller is not inside the Istio mesh.
WalletClient created without sourceId or module; thrown at boot.
Holding usage failed and was rolled back.

errors.action: Back off and repeat if retryable.
Back off and repeat if retryable.
Settle calls: repeat. Validate calls: don't, the hold may exist.

sets: minSdkVersion (below it: one DeprecationWarning, never blocked)

polling.label: First fetch
polling.value: Random 0–5 s after the client is created

polling.label: Gatekeeper failing
polling.value: Keeps the last good config; backs off 120 s → 240 s → 300 s max

polling.label: No config yet or invalid
polling.value: Built-in defaults. A config problem never fails a call

remoteConfig.changeHow: Static in apps/revex-wallet-gatekeeper/src/constants/sdkConfig.ts on the PR branch: edit it, bump version, deploy Gatekeeper. Until that PR merges the route doesn't exist, so every SDK client runs on built-in defaults.

metrics.name: gatekeeper_sdk_requests
metrics.labels: operation, outcome, error_code, status_code, source_id, module, sdk_version

headers.name: x-gatekeeper-sdk-version
headers.carries: SDK version, read from package.json at runtime

semantics.title: Mesh failures are only visible here
semantics.detail: A 503 or timeout from Istio never reaches Gatekeeper's logs. The SDK metrics count every call client-side, including 200 denials.

semantics.title: reserve: false is stricter on funds
semantics.detail: It runs the same policy and free-limit checks as a holding validate plus a funds check whenever the usage would be billable. A holding validate runs the funds check only for entities with no policy document and no template, so a governed entity can pass a hold on a negative balance and fail here.

semantics.title: hasFunds is the policy verdict
semantics.detail: On an allowed validate it is always true, even on a negative balance. Read balance and complimentaryCredits to judge the wallet.

semantics.title: fundCheck: false counts usage that already happened
semantics.detail: Gatekeeper holds and counts the usage past a balance or usage-limit denial instead of refusing. For post-usage charges on products allowed to bill past an empty wallet.

semantics.title: A repeated settle is a replay, not an error
semantics.detail: Gatekeeper documents an idempotent settle as 200 but answers 422; the SDK reads both as replayed: true. Other 422s still throw.

semantics.title: runBillable is switched off
semantics.detail: The validate → run → settle helper is commented out in 0.3.0. The six direct methods are the only supported path.

billableFlow.name: A billable action through wallet-sdk
billableFlow.trigger: A product is about to do billable work (send an SMS, run an AI step)

steps.name: validate
steps.title: validateCompanyEvent / validateLocationEvent
steps.detail: With reserveUsage. A denial throws ACCESS_DENIED.

steps.name: gk_validate
steps.title: POST validate-event: check policy and funds, hold usage, return eventId

steps.name: settle
steps.title: billEventSuccess with real usage, or billEventFailure if the work failed

steps.name: gk_settle
steps.title: PUT billevent/success: settle the hold to metricCount

success: Charged with real usage; a repeat returns replayed: true
failure: ACCESS_DENIED: block the action, nothing held
Work failed: billEventFailure releases the hold
BILL_RETRY_PENDING: charge parked, never call billEventFailure
